{{nihongo|'''Agata Shrine (Gifu)'''|縣神社 (岐阜市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Mino Province]].

'''Agata Shrine''' (あがたじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|Gifu Prefecture|ace|Prefektur Gifu|af|Gifu-prefektuur|an|Prefectura de Gifu|ar|غيفو (محافظة)|arz|جيفو (محافظه)|az|Gifu prefekturası|azb|قیفو اوستانی|ban|Préféktur Gifu|be|Гіфу (прэфектура)|bg|Гифу|bn|গিফু প্রশাসনিক অঞ্চল|ca|Prefectura de Gifu|cdo|Gifu-gâing|ce|Гифу (префектура)|ceb|Gifu-ken|ckb|پارێزگای گیفو|cs|Prefektura Gifu|cy|Gifu (talaith)|da|Gifu-præfekturet|de|Präfektur Gifu|eo|Gubernio Gifu|es|Prefectura de Gifu|et|Gifu prefektuur|eu|Gifu (prefektura)|fa|استان گیفو|fi|Gifun prefektuuri|fr|Préfecture de Gifu|frr|Gifu (Prefektüür)|ga|Maoracht Gifu|gl|Prefectura de Gifu|hak|Gifu-yen|he|גיפו (מחוז)|hr|Gifu (prefektura)|hu|Gifu prefektúra|hy|Գիֆու (պրեֆեկտուրա)|id|Prefektur Gifu|ilo|Prepektura ti Gifu|it|Prefettura di Gifu|ja|岐阜県|jv|Préfèktur Gifu|ka|გიფუს პრეფექტურა|kn|ಗಿಫು (ಪ್ರಾಂತ್ಯ)|ko|기후현|lt|Gifu prefektūra|lv|Gifu prefektūra|mk|Гифу (префектура)|mni|ꯒꯤꯐꯨ ꯂꯝꯈꯥꯢ|mr|गिफू प्रांत|ms|Wilayah Gifu|ne|गिफु|nl|Gifu (prefectuur)|no|Gifu (prefektur)|nov|Gifu Prefekture|os|Гифу (префектурæ)|pam|Prepektura ning Gifu|pl|Prefektura Gifu|pnb|ضلع گیفو|pt|Gifu|ro|Prefectura Gifu|ru|Гифу (префектура)|se|Gifu prefektuvra|sh|Prefektura Gifu|simple|Gifu Prefecture|sk|Gifu (prefektúra)|sr|Префектура Гифу|su|Préféktur Gifu|sv|Gifu prefektur|sw|Mkoa wa Gifu|tg|Префектураи Гифу|th|จังหวัดกิฟุ|tl|Prepektura ng Gifu|tr|Gifu (prefektörlük)|tt|Гифу (префектура)|uk|Префектура Ґіфу|ur|گیفو پریفیکچر|vi|Gifu|war|Gifu (prefektura)|wuu|岐阜县|zh|岐阜县|zh_classical|岐阜縣|zh_min_nan|Gihu-koān|zh_yue|岐阜縣|qid=Q131277}}{{ill|Gifu|Q45798|qid=Q45798}}.

It is identified as Katagata-tsu Shrine of {{ill|Mino Province|ckb|پارێزگای مینۆ|cs|Mino (provincie)|de|Provinz Mino|es|Provincia de Mino|eu|Mino probintzia|fa|ولایت مینو|fr|Province de Mino|gl|Provincia de Mino|hak|Mî-nùng-koet|id|Provinsi Mino|it|Mino (provincia)|ja|美濃国|ko|미노국|lt|Mino žemė|nl|Mino (provincie)|pt|Província de Mino|ru|Мино (провинция)|simple|Mino Province|sk|Mino (provincia)|sr|Провинција Мино|th|แคว้นมิโนะ|tr|Mino (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Міно|vi|Tỉnh Mino|wuu|美濃国|zh|美濃國|zh_min_nan|Mino-kok|zh_yue|美濃國|qid=Q864156}}{{ill|Katagata district|Q11504366|qid=Q11504366}} listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Engishiki}}. However, regarding Katagata-tsu Shrine of Katagata District in Mino Province, there are several other candidate shrines (ronsha), such as {{ill|Tsu Shrine|ja|津神社|qid=Q11556358}} and {{ill|Katagatatsu Shrine|ja|方県津神社|qid=Q11504365}}.

It is located in the northwestern part of Gifu City, near the boundary between {{ill|Yamagata District, Gifu|ja|山県郡 (岐阜県)|qid=Q8047620|lt=Yamagata District}} of Mino Province and Katagata District.

=== Enshrined deities ===
=== Principal deity ===
*Agata Ōkami  
:Details are unknown. Various theories identify this deity as Kunisazuchi-no-Mikoto, {{ill|Amatsuhikone|fa|آماتسوهیکونه|fr|Amatsuhikone|it|Amatsuhikone|ja|アマツヒコネ|zh|天津日子根命|qid=Q10940228|lt=Amatsuhikone-no-Mikoto}}, or {{ill|Sukunabikona|ca|Sukunabikona|fr|Sukunabikona|it|Sukuna-hikona|ja|スクナビコナ|ko|스쿠나비코나|mni|ꯁꯨꯀꯨꯅꯕꯤꯀꯣꯅ|pl|Sukunabikona|pt|Sukunahikona|simple|Sukunabikona|sv|Suku-Na-Bikona|zh|少彥名|qid=Q3275687|lt=Sukunahikona-no-Mikoto}}.
